article.story: CLARKSVILLE, Tenn. -- — Caden Bell’s 31 points led UT Rio Grande Valley over Austin Peay 79-73 in overtime on Saturday. Bell had eight rebounds for the Vaqueros (4-2). Darius Carr shot 5 for 10 (2 for 5 from 3-point range) and 3 of 6 from the free-throw line to add 15 points. Always Wright shot 4 for 10, including 1 for 5 from beyond the arc to finish with nine points. Zyree Collins finished with 26 points, five assists and three steals for the Governors (3-3). Austin Peay also got 17 points, nine rebounds and three blocks from Rashaud Marshall. Felipe Minzer finished with 11 points, seven rebounds, five assists and two steals. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
